scholarships.title: Tampere University tuition fee scholarship (50%) and early bird offer

existing.description: Tampere University offers a limited number of merit-based tuition fee scholarships, awarded at admission to exceptionally qualified applicants. The tuition fee scholarship covers 50% of the programme tuition fees for the whole programme duration. A separate early bird offer gives all fee-paying students who did not receive a tuition fee scholarship a EUR 2,000 reduction on the first-year tuition if they accept the place and pay within three weeks. Tuition fees for students admitted in 2027 are EUR 10,000 for bachelor's programmes and EUR 12,000 for master's programmes. Living costs are not covered.
eligibility: Citizen of a country outside the EU, EEA and Switzerland, or otherwise liable for tuition fees
Applying to a Tampere University bachelor's or master's programme taught in English
Applying during the programme's admission application period
Merited, high-achieving and motivated applicant (scholarships are merit-based)
existing.eligibility_summary: Fee-paying students, meaning applicants from outside the EU, EEA and Switzerland studying in a bachelor's or master's programme taught in English at Tampere University. Scholarships are not awarded in all programmes, and none are available through the open university route or transfer applications.
benefits: 50% tuition fee reduction for the full programme duration (tuition fee scholarship holders)
EUR 2,000 first-year tuition discount (early bird offer)
EUR 2,000 graduation scholarship for eligible Tampere University bachelor's graduates
coverage: Tampere University tuition fee scholarship: 50% of the tuition fees for the programme duration
Early bird offer: EUR 2,000 reduction on the first-year tuition fee

Graduation Scholarship: EUR 2,000 reduction on the first-year tuition of a Tampere University master's programme for graduates of a Tampere University bachelor's programme completed within three academic years
existing.english_requirement: Centre celebrates 50 years of teaching courageous communication
application_method: Apply to the degree programme at Studyinfo.fi during the admission period
Request the scholarship in the same online application
For the early bird offer: accept the study place and pay the reduced first-year tuition within three weeks of receiving the admission information
existing.best_fit: High-achieving non-EU/EEA/Swiss applicants to Tampere University's English-taught bachelor's and master's programmes who can fund their own living costs.
existing.notes: "There is a very limited number of scholarships available"; in admission 2026 only nine tuition fee scholarships were awarded across all bachelor's and master's programmes, and scholarships are not awarded in all programmes.
existing.duration: For the programme duration (tuition fee scholarship); the early bird discount applies to the first year of studies only
existing.application_period: Scholarships at admission 2027; applied for within the admission application
existing.deadline_display: "To be considered for Tampere University Scholarships, you must apply for the scholarship as part of your application for admission during the application period for admission. You will apply for Tampere University Scholarships with the same online application you use to apply for admission at Studyinfo.fi." The early bird offer requires accepting the study place and paying the reduced first-year tuition "within three weeks (21 days) after receiving information on admission."
existing.program_type: Merit-based partial tuition fee scholarship and tuition fee discount

scholarships.title: Åbo Akademi University tuition fee scholarship - early commitment offer and second-year reduction

existing.description: For students admitted to Åbo Akademi University international master's programmes from the autumn of 2026 onwards, the university replaced its 100% and 80% tuition fee waiver scheme with a EUR 4,000 early commitment discount in the first academic year, reducing the first-year fee to EUR 8,000, and an automatic EUR 4,000 tuition reduction in the second year. The first-year offer must be claimed by accepting the study place and paying tuition within the deadline specified in the admissions letter; failing that, the full EUR 12,000 is due. Tuition fee scholarships are granted only for the first two years of study.
eligibility: Admitted to an Åbo Akademi University international master's degree programme
Studies starting in the autumn of 2026 or later
For the first-year early commitment offer: accept the study place and pay the tuition fee within the deadline in the admissions letter
existing.eligibility_summary: Students liable to pay tuition fees who are admitted to an Åbo Akademi University international master's degree programme for studies starting in the autumn of 2026 or later. Everyone admitted and liable to pay fees receives the second-year reduction; the first-year early commitment offer must be claimed.
benefits: EUR 4,000 early commitment discount on the first-year tuition fee
EUR 4,000 automatic tuition fee reduction in the second year
Reduced annual tuition of EUR 8,000 instead of EUR 12,000 for the first two years
coverage: Early commitment offer: EUR 4,000 tuition discount, leaving EUR 8,000 for the first academic year
Second year: EUR 4,000 tuition fee reduction for all admitted students, leaving EUR 8,000
application_method: Apply to an international master's degree programme through the normal application process
Claim the early commitment offer by accepting the study place and paying tuition within the deadline in the admissions letter
No separate application is needed for the second-year reduction
existing.best_fit: Fee-paying applicants to Åbo Akademi University international master's programmes who can pay EUR 8,000 per year for the first two years.
existing.notes: The former 100% and 80% tuition fee waiver scheme applies only to students admitted in 2025 or earlier: "Scholarships mentioned for students admitted earlier are not available for those admitted in 2026 or later." "decisions regarding all scholarships mentioned below are final and may not be appealed".
existing.duration: Waivers are granted only for the first two years of study at Åbo Akademi University
existing.application_period: For students admitted for studies starting in the autumn of 2026 or later; the first-year offer is claimed through the admissions letter and the second-year reduction is automatic
existing.deadline_display: "Admitted students can claim the offer by accepting their study place and paying the tuition fee within a deadline specified in their admissions letter. Admitted students who do not accept their study place and do not pay the tuition fee within the deadline for the early commitment offer need to pay the full amount of 12000 €." For the second year, "Applicants do not need to apply separately for this second year scholarship."
existing.program_type: Tuition fee discount awarded on admission and continued automatically in year two
